description: Declare an SQL table as an external asset in the Dagster asset graph — makes it visible for lineage without materializing it from Dagster.

connection_string_env_var.label: Connection String Env Var
connection_string_env_var.description: Env var containing the SQLAlchemy connection string

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Dagster asset key for a single table. Mutually exclusive with `tables:` -- use this (with `table_name:`) for one table, or `tables:` to declare several from one component instance sharing connection_string_env_var and one observation sensor.

table_name.label: Table Name
table_name.description: Table name (use schema.table for non-default schemas) for a single table. Mutually exclusive with `tables:`.

tables.label: Tables
tables.description: Declare several tables as external assets from one component instance, instead of one ExternalSqlAsset YAML block (and, with create_observation_sensor=true, one polling sensor) per table. Each entry: `key` (Dagster asset key, required), `table_name` (required), plus optional `watermark_column`, `deps`, `owners`, `metadata`, `group_name`, `description`. All entries share this component's connection_string_env_var and (if enabled) ONE sensor that queries every table's row count/watermark per tick -- set `sensor_name` explicitly when using `tables:` with create_observation_sensor=true. Mutually exclusive with the top-level `asset_key`/`table_name` fields.

create_observation_sensor.label: Create Observation Sensor
create_observation_sensor.description: Also create the polling sensor that keeps this external asset's health/data-version current (same logic as the standalone sql_observation_sensor component). When False (default), this component only declares the AssetSpec.

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Unique sensor name. Defaults to '{asset_key}__observation_sensor' in single-table mode. Required when using `tables:` (no single table name to derive a default from). Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

watermark_column.label: Watermark Column
watermark_column.description: Column for latest value metric (e.g. updated_at). Used to derive the DataVersion in the native path. Single-table mode only -- set per-entry `watermark_column` under `tables:`. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between health checks. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key exposing `.observe(table_name) -> dict`. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for time-based partition types (e.g. '2024-01-01').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static / multi partition types.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: External SQL Asset
